resources.string: You can now download all lists within a specific group as a single combined PDF by long-pressing the group from the dashboard!
The UI now dynamically displays the total number of matching records whenever a search or filter is applied.
You\'re looking at it! We added this beautiful rainbow card dialog to help you discover new features directly from Settings.
We\'ve redesigned the Settings screen and standardized premium \'bounce\' touch animations across all buttons.
We\'ve improved string localization across the app and fixed a major crash related to background PDF generation.
